summary: Read the complete markdown conversion, including Appendices A-E, and verified both cited source quotes directly against PDF p. 53. The paper reports a 1-to-10 creativity evaluation and qualitatively higher quality with ChatGPT access, but no numerical effect, uncertainty, p-value, or analysis-specific participant count for this result. The null statistics and counts are appropriate. question, construct, unit, higher_is, outcome_with_ai, outcome_timing, within_person, comparison_type, se_basis, and the combined-AI versus Control contrast are supported.
